scope: exploratory training-validation study; no test scoring or new alarm claims
raw_input: last 8 seconds of BVP at each existing available 5-minute decision anchor
history: three consecutive anchors with each gap 300 +/- 5 seconds; actual elapsed seconds divided by 600; no gaps bridged
labels: source glucose_mg_dl < 70; nonfinite reference omitted with counts
context: all missing; no person-level demographics verified in this source
encoder: pinned frozen Pulse-PPG, bounded-window preprocessing PPG_TRANSFER1
selection: highest validation AP, tie lowest Brier then fewer trainable parameters; all candidates retained
limits: Single validation participant, not optimal global hyperparameters
All source subjects historically inspected, not independent external validation
Diagnostic comparison does not replace original 30-event evaluation
amendment: After FIT1, timestamp-only audit found frequent 299/301s jitter. Same participants and 18 candidates, revised support. Exploratory validation selection, not an independent gain estimate.
